item.title: Hello Singularity
item.description:
“The singularity is a point where all known laws of physics break down.”

Welcome to **X's Singularity Notes**.
欢迎来到 **X's Singularity Notes**。
This is a space at the event horizon of thought. In the world of black holes, a singularity is a place of infinite density and zero volume—a point where information is compressed to its absolute essence.
这是一个矗立在思想视界线上的空间。在黑洞的世界里，奇点是一个密度无限大、体积为零的地方——信息被压缩到绝对本质的那一刻。
This blog follows the same philosophy: **Extreme minimalism.** Black and white. Thoughts stripped of noise, leaving only the signal.
这个博客遵循同样的理念：**极致极简。** 黑与白。剥离噪音的思想，只留下信号。
Expect notes on:
期待以下主题的笔记：
  • Time Illusion / 时间幻象
  • Immortal Paradox / 长生悖论
  • Determined Chaos / 宿命混沌
  • The Last Free Will / 最后的自由意志
  • Ghost in the Machine / 机器幽灵
  • Mechanical Ascension / 机械飞升
Stay tuned.
敬请期待。
